Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Monster Soups can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Monster Extract]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Fresh Milk]], and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Due to Monster Extract being required to make them, the amount of [[Heart]]s restored to [[Link]] is random each time these soups are made. The same also applies to the strength and duration of any status effects. Since Monster Extract is used as a base, the soup is distinctly gamy. By adding more [[Ingredient]]s, Link can create several different variations of Monster Soup: * '''Chilly Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Monster Soup}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. These soups will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Monster Soup}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Monster Soup}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Link can eat them to completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Monster Soup}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. When eaten, a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel will be refilled. * '''Hasty Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Monster Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Monster Soup}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these soups will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Monster Soup}}

Using monster extract as a base, this soup's distinct gaminess is either loved or hated.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Monster Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Monster Soup}}
